title: client_health_score
description: Memory block written by Agent 6.2 (Client Reporting). The internal, machine-readable companion to the monthly client-facing narrative ROI report: a composite client_health_score (0-100) plus its component sub-scores, the period's headline ROI/KPI results reconciled against the active kpi_contracts, retention/churn signals, and the account-management recommendation. The client-facing report itself (ES-MX, per the brand formatting guide) is OUTPUT 2; this block is the internal account-management record (no COGS / margins / performance-bonus figures ever appear here or in the report). Read by internal account management for renewal / upsell / churn-risk triage. Human gate: required before the report is delivered to the client (pre-client tier) -> defaults to pending_review. | Reads upstream: performance_history (6.1), active_strategy (2.1), client_profile (1.1). | First authored: 2026-05-29.

kpi.description: KPI name as it appears in the kpi_contracts (e.g. 'leads_per_month', 'cpl_usd', 'roas', 'conversion_rate_pct', 'reach_per_month').

unit.description: Unit of the KPI: 'count', 'usd', 'ratio', 'pct'. Null if dimensionless.

target.description: Contracted target for the period from kpi_contracts. Null if no target was set (learning mode).

actual.description: Measured actual for the period from performance_history. Null if not yet measurable.

attainment_pct.description: actual vs target as a percentage (100 = on target). For inverse KPIs like cpl_usd, lower-is-better is reflected in 'status', not the raw ratio.

status.description: Reconciliation verdict for this KPI against its contract.

lower_is_better.description: True for cost KPIs (e.g. cpl_usd, cpa_usd) where actual below target is good.

client_id.description: Client identifier. Format: lowercase-hyphenated. Example: acme-co

schema_version.description: Schema version. Increment on breaking changes.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime this report/health-score record was generated.

gate_status.description: Human gate status. pre-client tier: the report must be 'approved' by the operator before it is delivered to the client. Defaults to pending_review.

report_language.description: Language of the client-facing narrative report (OUTPUT 2). Default 'es-MX' for LATAM clients.

label.description: Human label for the period, ES-MX where client-facing (e.g. 'Abril 2026').

start_date.description: First day of the reporting period (YYYY-MM-DD).

end_date.description: Last day of the reporting period (YYYY-MM-DD).

market.description: Primary market this report covers (Mexico | Colombia | Dominican Republic | Puerto Rico), or null for all-markets.

composite.description: Overall client-health score 0-100. Internal account-management signal; NOT shown verbatim to the client.

band.description: Banded interpretation of the composite score.

trend.description: Direction vs the prior period's composite. Null if no prior period.

previous_composite.description: Prior period composite for trend context. Null on first report.

components.description: Weighted sub-scores (each 0-100) that roll into the composite.

kpi_attainment.description: How well KPI contracts were met this period.

engagement.description: Content/channel engagement vs plan (reach, CTR, opens, replies).

retention_signal.description: Composite of renewal proximity, sentiment, and usage/responsiveness signals.

roi_summary.description: Headline ROI for the period. All figures are CLIENT marketing economics (their ad spend, their attributed revenue) -- never Acme Co. COGS, margins, cost-to-serve, or performance-bonus figures.

narrative.description: One- to two-sentence ES-MX plain-language ROI statement for the client (e.g. 'Por cada peso invertido en pauta generamos X en ingresos atribuidos').

marketing_spend_usd.description: Client's total marketing/ad spend in the period (USD). Null if no paid media ran.

attributed_revenue_usd.description: Revenue attributed to marketing in the period (USD). Null in pre-launch / no-conversion-data mode.

roas.description: Return on ad spend (attributed_revenue_usd / marketing_spend_usd). Null if spend is 0 or revenue not attributable.

cpl_usd.description: Cost per lead in the period (USD).

confidence.description: Honesty flag on the ROI figures. 'learning_mode' = pre-launch / insufficient data; the report must say so plainly instead of inventing numbers.

kpi_scorecard.description: Per-KPI reconciliation of active_strategy/kpi_contracts targets against performance_history actuals for the period. May be empty in learning mode (no contracted KPIs yet).

highlights.description: 2-4 ES-MX client-facing wins for the period (what worked).

lowlights.description: 1-3 ES-MX client-facing honest under-performances (what missed and why).

action.description: ES-MX client-facing recommended action for next period.

next_actions.description: Forward-looking recommendations tying each action to the next cycle's objective (ROI focus).

renewal_date.description: Contract renewal date (YYYY-MM-DD), or null if unknown.

churn_risk.description: Internal churn-risk read for account management.

upsell_opportunity.description: Internal note on tier-upgrade / scope-expansion opportunity. NOT client-facing.

retention.description: Internal account-management signals. Never surfaced in the client report.

action.description: Recommended operator action at the pre-client gate. 'approve_and_send' only when figures are reconciled and confidentiality-clean.

rationale.description: EN one-line justification for the operator.

recommendation.description: The pre-client-delivery gate recommendation. gate_status must be consistent with this (approve_and_send pairs with an operator-approved send; default pending_review).
